family.template: Two angles of a triangle are {a}° and {b}°. What is the third angle, in degrees?

stem.en: Two angles of a triangle are {a}° and {b}°. What is the third angle, in degrees?
stem.uz: Uchburchakning ikki burchagi {a}° va {b}°. Uchinchi burchagini toping (gradusda).
stem.ru: Два угла треугольника равны {a}° и {b}°. Найдите третий угол (в градусах).

why.en: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°.
why.uz: Uchburchak burchaklarining yigʻindisi 180°.
why.ru: Сумма углов треугольника равна 180°.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: In an isosceles triangle the angle between the two equal sides is {a}°. What is each of the other two angles, in degrees?

stem.en: In an isosceles triangle the angle between the two equal sides is {a}°. What is each of the other two angles, in degrees?
stem.uz: Teng yonli uchburchakda teng tomonlar orasidagi burchak {a}°. Qolgan ikki burchakning har biri necha gradus?
stem.ru: В равнобедренном треугольнике угол между равными сторонами равен {a}°. Чему равен каждый из двух других углов (в градусах)?

why.en: The two base angles are equal: (180° − top angle) ÷ 2.
why.uz: Asosdagi ikki burchak teng: (180° − uchidagi burchak) : 2.
why.ru: Углы при основании равны: (180° − угол при вершине) : 2.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: In triangle ABC, ∠A = {a}° and ∠B = {b}°. What is the exterior angle at vertex C, in degrees?

stem.en: In triangle ABC, ∠A = {a}° and ∠B = {b}°. What is the exterior angle at vertex C, in degrees?
stem.uz: ABC uchburchakda ∠A = {a}° va ∠B = {b}°. C uchidagi tashqi burchakni toping (gradusda).
stem.ru: В треугольнике ABC ∠A = {a}°, ∠B = {b}°. Найдите внешний угол при вершине C (в градусах).

why.en: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two interior angles that are not next to it.
why.uz: Tashqi burchak unga qoʻshni boʻlmagan ikki ichki burchak yigʻindisiga teng.
why.ru: Внешний угол равен сумме двух внутренних углов, не смежных с ним.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: What is the sum of the interior angles of a convex polygon with {n} sides, in degrees?

stem.en: What is the sum of the interior angles of a convex polygon with {n} sides, in degrees?
stem.uz: {n} ta tomoni bor qavariq koʻpburchak ichki burchaklarining yigʻindisini toping (gradusda).
stem.ru: Найдите сумму внутренних углов выпуклого многоугольника с {n} сторонами (в градусах).

why.en: Sum = (n − 2) × 180°, because the polygon splits into n − 2 triangles.
why.uz: Yigʻindi = (n − 2) × 180°, chunki koʻpburchak n − 2 ta uchburchakka boʻlinadi.
why.ru: Сумма = (n − 2) × 180°, так как многоугольник делится на n − 2 треугольника.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: What is each interior angle of a regular polygon with {n} sides, in degrees?

stem.en: What is each interior angle of a regular polygon with {n} sides, in degrees?
stem.uz: {n} ta tomoni bor muntazam koʻpburchakning har bir ichki burchagi necha gradus?
stem.ru: Чему равен каждый внутренний угол правильного многоугольника с {n} сторонами (в градусах)?

why.en: Each exterior angle is 360° ÷ n, and the interior angle is 180° minus that.
why.uz: Har bir tashqi burchak 360° : n ga, ichki burchak esa 180° dan shuni ayirganiga teng.
why.ru: Каждый внешний угол равен 360° : n, а внутренний — 180° минус внешний.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A right triangle has legs of {a} cm and {b} cm. What is the length of its hypotenuse, in cm?

stem.en: A right triangle has legs of {a} cm and {b} cm. What is the length of its hypotenuse, in cm?
stem.uz: Toʻgʻri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari {a} sm va {b} sm. Gipotenuzasi necha sm?
stem.ru: Катеты прямоугольного треугольника равны {a} см и {b} см. Найдите гипотенузу (в см).

why.en: Pythagoras: hypotenuse² = leg² + leg², then take the square root.
why.uz: Pifagor teoremasi: gipotenuza² = katet² + katet², soʻng kvadrat ildiz oling.
why.ru: Теорема Пифагора: гипотенуза² = катет² + катет², затем извлеките корень.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of {c} cm and one leg of {a} cm. How long is the other leg, in cm?

stem.en: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of {c} cm and one leg of {a} cm. How long is the other leg, in cm?
stem.uz: Toʻgʻri burchakli uchburchakning gipotenuzasi {c} sm, bir kateti {a} sm. Ikkinchi kateti necha sm?
stem.ru: Гипотенуза прямоугольного треугольника равна {c} см, один катет — {a} см. Найдите второй катет (в см).

why.en: Other leg² = hypotenuse² − known leg², then take the square root.
why.uz: Ikkinchi katet² = gipotenuza² − maʼlum katet², soʻng kvadrat ildiz oling.
why.ru: Второй катет² = гипотенуза² − известный катет², затем извлеките корень.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A rectangle measures {a} cm by {b} cm. What is its area, in cm²?

stem.en: A rectangle measures {a} cm by {b} cm. What is its area, in cm²?
stem.uz: Toʻgʻri toʻrtburchakning tomonlari {a} sm va {b} sm. Uning yuzi necha sm²?
stem.ru: Стороны прямоугольника равны {a} см и {b} см. Найдите его площадь (в см²).

why.en: Area of a rectangle = length × width.
why.uz: Toʻgʻri toʻrtburchak yuzi = boʻyi × eni.
why.ru: Площадь прямоугольника = длина × ширина.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A rectangle has an area of {A} cm² and a width of {w} cm. What is its perimeter, in cm?

stem.en: A rectangle has an area of {A} cm² and a width of {w} cm. What is its perimeter, in cm?
stem.uz: Toʻgʻri toʻrtburchakning yuzi {A} sm², eni {w} sm. Uning perimetri necha sm?
stem.ru: Площадь прямоугольника {A} см², ширина {w} см. Найдите его периметр (в см).

why.en: Length = area ÷ width; perimeter = 2 × (length + width).
why.uz: Boʻyi = yuza : eni; perimetr = 2 × (boʻyi + eni).
why.ru: Длина = площадь : ширина; периметр = 2 × (длина + ширина).

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A triangle has a base of {b} cm and a height of {h} cm. What is its area, in cm²?

stem.en: A triangle has a base of {b} cm and a height of {h} cm. What is its area, in cm²?
stem.uz: Uchburchakning asosi {b} sm, balandligi {h} sm. Uning yuzi necha sm²?
stem.ru: Основание треугольника {b} см, высота {h} см. Найдите его площадь (в см²).

why.en: Area of a triangle = base × height ÷ 2.
why.uz: Uchburchak yuzi = asos × balandlik : 2.
why.ru: Площадь треугольника = основание × высота : 2.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A trapezoid has parallel sides of {a} cm and {b} cm and a height of {h} cm. What is its area, in cm²?

stem.en: A trapezoid has parallel sides of {a} cm and {b} cm and a height of {h} cm. What is its area, in cm²?
stem.uz: Trapetsiyaning asoslari {a} sm va {b} sm, balandligi {h} sm. Uning yuzi necha sm²?
stem.ru: Основания трапеции равны {a} см и {b} см, высота — {h} см. Найдите её площадь (в см²).

why.en: Area of a trapezoid = (sum of the parallel sides) ÷ 2 × height.
why.uz: Trapetsiya yuzi = (asoslar yigʻindisi) : 2 × balandlik.
why.ru: Площадь трапеции = (сумма оснований) : 2 × высота.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A circle has a radius of {r} cm. Its circumference is kπ cm. What is k?

stem.en: A circle has a radius of {r} cm. Its circumference is kπ cm. What is k?
stem.uz: Aylananing radiusi {r} sm. Uning uzunligi kπ sm ga teng. k ni toping.
stem.ru: Радиус окружности {r} см. Её длина равна kπ см. Найдите k.

why.en: Circumference = 2πr.
why.uz: Aylana uzunligi = 2πr.
why.ru: Длина окружности = 2πr.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A circle has a diameter of {d} cm. Its area is kπ cm². What is k?

stem.en: A circle has a diameter of {d} cm. Its area is kπ cm². What is k?
stem.uz: Doiraning diametri {d} sm. Uning yuzi kπ sm² ga teng. k ni toping.
stem.ru: Диаметр круга {d} см. Его площадь равна kπ см². Найдите k.

why.en: Radius = diameter ÷ 2, and area = πr².
why.uz: Radius = diametr : 2, yuza = πr².
why.ru: Радиус = диаметр : 2, площадь = πr².

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A box is {a} cm long, {b} cm wide and {c} cm high. What is its volume, in cm³?

stem.en: A box is {a} cm long, {b} cm wide and {c} cm high. What is its volume, in cm³?
stem.uz: Qutining uzunligi {a} sm, eni {b} sm, balandligi {c} sm. Uning hajmi necha sm³?
stem.ru: Длина коробки {a} см, ширина {b} см, высота {c} см. Найдите её объём (в см³).

why.en: Volume of a box = length × width × height.
why.uz: Quti hajmi = uzunlik × en × balandlik.
why.ru: Объём коробки = длина × ширина × высота.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A cube has edges of {a} cm. What is its total surface area, in cm²?

stem.en: A cube has edges of {a} cm. What is its total surface area, in cm²?
stem.uz: Kubning qirrasi {a} sm. Uning toʻla sirti yuzi necha sm²?
stem.ru: Ребро куба равно {a} см. Найдите площадь его полной поверхности (в см²).

why.en: A cube has 6 equal square faces: 6 × edge².
why.uz: Kubning 6 ta teng kvadrat yogʻi bor: 6 × qirra².
why.ru: У куба 6 одинаковых квадратных граней: 6 × ребро².

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: Triangles ABC and DEF are similar (A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F). AB = {a}, DE = {d} and BC = {b}. What is EF?

stem.en: Triangles ABC and DEF are similar (A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F). AB = {a}, DE = {d} and BC = {b}. What is EF?
stem.uz: ABC va DEF uchburchaklar oʻxshash (A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F). AB = {a}, DE = {d}, BC = {b}. EF ni toping.
stem.ru: Треугольники ABC и DEF подобны (A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F). AB = {a}, DE = {d}, BC = {b}. Найдите EF.

why.en: Corresponding sides are in the same ratio: EF = BC × DE ÷ AB.
why.uz: Mos tomonlar bir xil nisbatda: EF = BC × DE : AB.
why.ru: Соответственные стороны пропорциональны: EF = BC × DE : AB.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: What is the distance between the points ({x1}, {y1}) and ({x2}, {y2})?

stem.en: What is the distance between the points ({x1}, {y1}) and ({x2}, {y2})?
stem.uz: ({x1}; {y1}) va ({x2}; {y2}) nuqtalar orasidagi masofani toping.
stem.ru: Найдите расстояние между точками ({x1}; {y1}) и ({x2}; {y2}).

why.en: Distance = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²): Pythagoras on the coordinate grid.
why.uz: Masofa = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²): koordinatalardagi Pifagor teoremasi.
why.ru: Расстояние = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²): теорема Пифагора на координатной плоскости.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: M is the midpoint of segment AB, where A({x1}, {y1}) and B({x2}, {y2}). What is the x-coordinate of M?

stem.en: M is the midpoint of segment AB, where A({x1}, {y1}) and B({x2}, {y2}). What is the x-coordinate of M?
stem.uz: M nuqta AB kesmaning oʻrtasi, bunda A({x1}; {y1}) va B({x2}; {y2}). M nuqtaning abssissasini (x koordinatasini) toping.
stem.ru: Точка M — середина отрезка AB, где A({x1}; {y1}) и B({x2}; {y2}). Найдите абсциссу (координату x) точки M.

why.en: The midpoint's x-coordinate is the average of the two x-coordinates.
why.uz: Oʻrta nuqtaning x koordinatasi uchlar x koordinatalarining oʻrta arifmetigiga teng.
why.ru: Координата x середины — среднее арифметическое координат x концов отрезка.

instructions.uz: Javobni son bilan kiriting (manfiy son boʻlsa, minus belgisini qoʻying).
instructions.ru: Введите ответ числом (для отрицательного числа поставьте знак минус).

family.template: In a circle of radius {r} cm, an arc has a central angle of {a}°. Its length is kπ cm. What is k?

stem.en: In a circle of radius {r} cm, an arc has a central angle of {a}°. Its length is kπ cm. What is k?
stem.uz: Radiusi {r} sm boʻlgan aylanada markaziy burchagi {a}° boʻlgan yoyning uzunligi kπ sm ga teng. k ni toping.
stem.ru: В окружности радиуса {r} см дуга имеет центральный угол {a}°. Её длина равна kπ см. Найдите k.

why.en: Arc length = (central angle ÷ 360°) × 2πr.
why.uz: Yoy uzunligi = (markaziy burchak : 360°) × 2πr.
why.ru: Длина дуги = (центральный угол : 360°) × 2πr.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: A square has a perimeter of {p} cm. What is its area, in cm²?

stem.en: A square has a perimeter of {p} cm. What is its area, in cm²?
stem.uz: Kvadratning perimetri {p} sm. Uning yuzi necha sm²?
stem.ru: Периметр квадрата {p} см. Найдите его площадь (в см²).

why.en: Side = perimeter ÷ 4, and area = side².
why.uz: Tomoni = perimetr : 4, yuzi = tomon².
why.ru: Сторона = периметр : 4, площадь = сторона².
